name: PM-KISAN
description: Direct income support of Rs.6000 per year in three installments to farmer families.

name: PMFBY - Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
description: Crop insurance scheme covering losses due to natural calamities, pests and diseases.

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Free soil testing and health card with crop-wise nutrient recommendations for every farmer.

name: PM Kisan Maandhan Yojana
description: Pension scheme for small and marginal farmers providing Rs.3000 per month after age 60.

name: Kisan Credit Card
description: Affordable credit for seeds, fertilizers, equipment and other agricultural needs.

name: Rice MSP Procurement
description: Government procurement of rice at Minimum Support Price with bonus incentives.

name: Wheat MSP Procurement
description: Government procurement of wheat at Minimum Support Price.

name: National Mission on Oilseeds
description: Support for oilseed crop farmers including seeds, training and price support.

name: Tamil Nadu CM Farmer Security Scheme
description: Life insurance coverage of Rs.2 lakh for registered farmers in Tamil Nadu.

name: Maharashtra Shetkari Sanman Yojana
description: Direct cash assistance to registered farmers in Maharashtra for agricultural inputs.

name: Karnataka Raitha Siri
description: Income support scheme for farmers in Karnataka providing direct financial assistance.

name: Andhra Pradesh YSR Rythu Bharosa
description: Investment support of Rs.13,500 per year to every agricultural family in Andhra Pradesh.
